Context: 1. Applicable to a dependent family member of.-

From 25-2-2015, "Married Son" can be considered for Compassionate Appointment, provided he fulfils all other requirements of the scheme and  
fulfils the criteria laid down in the OM, dated 16-1-2013.  
- OMs, dated 25-2-2015 and 5-9-2016.  
Compassionate appointment can  
In the case of a missing employee.be considered after two years from the date of missing-  
- (a)
- if FIR has been filed and the missing official is not traceable;
- (b)
- if he had at least two years to retire;
